sources.substitution: Each p-average has a symmetric doubly stochastic matrix. Set q_i=p, M_t=p P_t, rho=1/p. The graph has one p-clique and r isolated vertices, hence r+1 connected components. Scale initial variance as required by Section 2.
sources.use: External cross-check only. This theorem does not imply deterministic polynomial reachability. The local largest-gap theorem is proved directly and does not rely on this external source.
